title: Inspection of the Air Cycle Machine, Silencer and Mount Installation
abstract: Scheduled inspection of the air cycle machine, its outlet silencer and its mount installation in the pack bay, covering rotor free rotation, mount condition and the acoustic check on modified aircraft.

sections.purpose: This task inspects the air cycle machine, its outlet silencer and its mount installation for damage, wear and security, and on aircraft with the tuned silencer verifies the acoustic result by a cabin sound level measurement.
sections.job_setup_note: The pack must be isolated from the bleed supply and allowed to cool for at least one hour before access. The pack bay is confined and hot; check the surface temperature before you reach inside. Where the aircraft has the elastomeric decoupled mount, the mount condition check has different limits from the rigid mount, so confirm the standard first.
sections.procedure: 1. Isolate the bleed supply to the pack and let it cool for at least one hour. WARNING: PACK BAY SURFACES REMAIN HOT FOR A LONG PERIOD AFTER SHUTDOWN. CHECK THE SURFACE TEMPERATURE BEFORE YOU REACH INSIDE. 2. Open the belly fairing panels and get access to the pack bay in zones 191 and 192. 3. Turn the machine rotor by hand and confirm free rotation with no rubbing. 4. Inspect the outlet silencer KEDE723823-59 for cracking at the weld line and for liner delamination. 5. Inspect the hose LU579123-82 for chafing at the clip positions and for hardening at the bends. 6. Inspect the mount feet and the washers EN911564K9 for cracking, extrusion or set. CAUTION: THE ELASTOMERIC MOUNT WASHER AND THE RIGID WASHER HAVE DIFFERENT REJECTION LIMITS. CONFIRM THE MOUNT STANDARD BEFORE YOU MEASURE THE SET. 7. Inspect the bypass restrictor D2150113216257 for security and confirm the datum setting. 8. Check the filter of FIN 312HM and the non-return valve of FIN 33HQ for security and correct locking. 9. Check that the pipe of FIN 4HM is clipped clear of the silencer body. 10. Restore the bleed supply and do the pack operational test. 11. On aircraft with the tuned silencer, measure the cabin sound level at the rear seat rows during the next cruise and record it.
sections.close_out: Close the belly fairing panels and confirm the fastener security. Remove the tools from the pack bay and confirm nothing has been left behind. Record the rotor rotation, the mount condition and, where measured, the cabin sound level against the aircraft. Report any silencer cracking before release to service.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft; the acoustic check applies post MOD-152860

safety_precautions: Isolate the bleed supply and let the pack cool for at least one hour.
Check the surface temperature before you reach into the pack bay.
Wear gloves rated for hot surfaces.
Confirm nothing is left in the bay before you close the fairing.

tooling.description: Mount set gauge, elastomeric and rigid
